items.text: Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the Rams' final offensive snap vs Washington and will undergo MRI Monday; team believes ACL is intact per Schefter/Garafolo. Late-game injury after 14-150-1 performance.
items.why: Low hit on rush, walked off; prior PCL history on same knee raises concern but ACL intact belief.
items.implication: Major blow if multi-week; Rams already missing Davante Adams (IR hamstring). Monitor MRI for Week 10 vs ARI.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Rams WRs/TEs if out.

items.text: Seahawks HC Macdonald ruling out Sam Darnold Week 10 vs LV; Drew Lock oblique tests 'good' and believed can start. ETR flagged Lock oblique.
items.why: Multi-injury setback (rib etc); Lock minor strain.
items.implication: Lock starts; SEA offense change for fantasy WRs/RBs.
items.opportunity: Jaxon Smith-Njigba etc volume with backup QB.

items.text: Notable RB usage Week 9: Breece Hall 19 opportunities vs Braelon Allen 10 on return (Allen outsnapped 37-27); DEN Jonah Coleman 58 snaps/ dominant last 2 wks vs JK Dobbins 11; SEA Charbonnet outsnapped/routed Jadarian Price; LV Jeanty 32 snaps/24 routes (even carries) in trail vs Washington.
items.why: Snap/opportunity/route shares post-injury returns and scripts.
items.implication: Hall still lead but timeshare; Coleman clear lead DEN; Charbonnet preferred SEA; Jeanty workhorse even trail.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Jeanty/Charbonnet elevated roles; monitor Hall/Allen split.
items.conflict: Hall opp lead but snap deficit.

items.text: Justin Herbert sustained left middle finger (non-throwing) injury in 4th of loss to Texans; Harbaugh said it could be a fracture, testing underway. Herbert expects to play Week 10 vs BAL, wants to stay in but was pulled.
items.why: Fended off rusher then braced fall; same finger fractured prior season.
items.implication: Non-throwing hand so likely playable with padding; backup Uiagalelei saw garbage time. Extra day for MNF.
items.opportunity: If out, Uiagalelei start; Ladd McConkey already limited.

items.text: Josh Jacobs fractured a finger (right) in 1Q vs NE after stiff-arm, limited to 4 carries/5 yds + fumble and did not return; LaFleur hopes to protect it so he can play but gripping issues.
items.why: Hand stuck in facemask; hard time gripping ball.
items.implication: Uncertain for Week 10 vs MIN; could play through with protection. Kaleb Johnson led rushers in his absence.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snaps rise if limited or out (MarShawn Lloyd inactive prior).

items.text: Patrick Mahomes MRI on elbow (strain/sprain) after returning to game shows no major injury; will monitor pain/swelling next days. Reid: more positive, rehab soreness. Worthy also hamstring.
items.why: Returned to game; tests clear of major structural.
items.implication: Expected to play Week 10; limited practice possible. Worthy hamstring watch separate.
items.opportunity: Full Mahomes keeps KC offense humming; Worthy role if limited.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle exited early vs CAR after high-low hit, ruled out with concussion; Broncos have bye Week 10 so targets return Nov 22 vs LV. Payton not concerned on seriousness.
items.why: Violent hit extending for catch; mandatory protocol.
items.implication: Misses remainder + bye cushion; Courtland Sutton/Pat Bryant/Mims elevated.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson suffered late knee injury vs GB, ruled out remainder after locker room; Pats awaiting MRI Monday. Had 6-32 rush + 3-46-1 rec before exit. TreVeyon Henderson already out illness.
items.why: Late 3Q injury, walked off under own power then out.
items.implication: Week 10 vs DET (Munich) in doubt; Corey Kiner/Lan Larison next up.
items.opportunity: Kiner lead-back opportunity if Stevenson misses.

items.text: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) OUT vs IND; Ryan Flournoy the obvious pivot and profiles as solid WR2 today.
items.why: Multiple sources confirm Pickens inactive; Flournoy next man.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 upside for Flournoy in DAL offense with Lamb.

items.text: Tightest 2-player target concentrations: NYG Nabers+Likely 54.9%; ARI McBride+Michael Wilson 50.7%; DAL Lamb+Pickens 50.6%; DET St. Brown+LaPorta 49.3%; GB Golden+Watson 48.7%. Tee+Chase 47.3%. Deep aDOT (Mitchell 18.4) = volatility.
items.why: Season-long target share data to top 2.
items.implication: High concentration = boom/bust or clear hierarchy; Pickens miss dilutes DAL. Deep targets volatile.
items.opportunity: Wilson/McBride reliable ARI; Watson/Golden GB surge.

items.text: Giants QB JJ McCarthy hip pointer in win at PHI but team confident ready for TNF vs WAS; Harbaugh 'doing well' 'looks like he’s going to play'.
items.implication: Nabers/Likely stack intact for short week.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but 0 snaps vs HOU due to pregame back spasms (second time in 3 games unavailable despite active). Mounting injury history (ribs/foot/concussion).
items.why: Back spasms pregame after prior foot/concussion issues.
items.implication: Unreliable; Herbert finger compounds Chargers WR volatility for Week 10 MNF.

items.text: Jordan Love/Christian Watson/Matthew Golden explosion bananas/amazing/impressive (Love 23/29 372-3TD; Watson 7-171-1; Golden 10-164-1). Easy root for Tank Dell too.
items.why: Historic production day for GB pass catchers.
items.implication: Watson/Golden elevated ROS if sustained; Love ceiling high.
items.opportunity: GB WR committee but high volume.

items.text: Projections updated for George Pickens (hamstring) INACTIVE Week 9.
items.implication: ETR/Levitan adjusted; Flournoy pivot as Berry noted.
